d: What if you had to spend ₹37 lakh and three years at university to become an influencer? That is the debate sparked by a content creation degree offered by a UK university. The course teaches students video production, podcasting, social media strategy, audience analytics and how to turn content into a business. And universities are responding to a booming creator economy, with millions of people hoping to make a living online, Is content creation worth a university degree or are we paying a premium to learn how to go viral? Palki Sharma tells you.
